title: Starfall Protocol
description: A mod for those who want to explore the minecraft world.
body:
StarFall Protocol brings cosmic chaos and mysterious power to your Minecraft world.
When meteors crash from the sky, they bring alien materials and a gateway to the unknown depths below...

💫 Features:

☄️ Meteor

Meteors fall from the heavens, leaving behind Dark Ice, an ultra-slippery material unlike any normal ice.

At the heart of each meteor lies the Meteor Core, the only source of the rare Energy Core — a key component for crafting powerful energy-based tools.

🕳️ New Cave – The Dark Abyss

A new subterranean biome filled with eerie shadows and rare resources.

Discover Lumithite, a glowing, potent ore used to enhance Netherite tools to new levels of strength and brilliance.

⚡ Energy Evolution
Master the fusion of cosmic and earthly elements to forge tools that harness pure celestial energy.
